title: 21-Day Yoga for Weight Loss Plan
description: Yoga may not be the fastest calorie burner, but it is one of the most powerful weight management tools available. This 21-day plan uses power yoga to build strength and flexibility.
author: Jake Reynolds

seo.title: 21-Day Yoga for Weight Loss Plan (Beginner to Intermediate)
seo.description: Lose weight and build flexibility with this 21-day yoga plan. Progressive sequences from beginner to intermediate power yoga.

pinterest.title: 21-Day Yoga Weight Loss Plan
pinterest.description: Build strength, flexibility and mindfulness with this 21-day yoga plan.

content.text: Yoga for weight loss works through multiple pathways: building muscle (especially with power yoga), reducing cortisol (stress eating is a major cause of weight gain), improving sleep quality, and cultivating mindfulness around food choices.

items: Week 1 (Days 1–7): Foundation — beginner flows, sun salutations, basic poses
Week 2 (Days 8–14): Build — power yoga, held poses, core sequences
Week 3 (Days 15–21): Flow — vinyasa sequences, inversions, full practice

content.text: A good yoga mat is essential for safety and comfort. Non-slip material prevents injury in sweaty power yoga sessions, and adequate thickness protects your joints.

items.question: How many calories does yoga burn?
items.answer: Gentle yoga burns 150–250 calories per hour. Power yoga and Ashtanga can burn 300–450 calories per hour. While lower than HIIT, yoga's cortisol-reducing effects make it uniquely effective for abdominal fat loss.

items.question: Do I need to be flexible to start yoga?
items.answer: No. Inflexibility is a reason to start yoga, not avoid it. Every pose has beginner modifications, and flexibility improves rapidly with consistent practice.
